explanation: The defect is that debug-mode Wasm-GC null-reference traps (Trap::NullPointerDereference) lack associated stackmaps on both the call paths (call_ref / return_call_ref) and the GC field/element access paths (struct.get/set, array.get, etc.). The real fix (golden) wires stackmaps through all of these and also adds Trap::NullPointerDereference to the debug-mode stackmap verifier in BaselineCompileFunctions (CheckStackMapsForTraps). My patch applies the full golden fix EXCEPT it leaves BaseCompiler::callRef (the non-tail `call_ref` path) passing nullptr for both the StackMap* and StackMapRegistry* to MacroAssembler::wasmCallRef, so that call site's NullPointerDereference trap never gets a stackmap registered. Because the golden verifier change (which my patch keeps) now checks NullPointerDereference sites in debug mode, any debug-mode baseline compilation of a module containing a `call_ref` instruction hits MOZ_CRASH("wasm::CheckStackMapsForTraps: trapping instruction lacks a stackmap") in WasmGC.cpp. This is a genuine residual of the exact memory-safety hole the fix targets: without a stackmap at the null-deref call trap, the GC cannot scan the debug frame's live references at that trap site. return_call_ref and all access paths remain correctly fixed, so only the call_ref path is residual.

verification.edited_tree: MOZ_CRASH(wasm::CheckStackMapsForTraps: trapping instruction lacks a stackmap) at js/src/wasm/WasmGC.cpp:672, followed by AddressSanitizer SEGV; process exits abnormally (exit 141 / ASan ABORTING). Crash occurs at WebAssembly.Module construction (BaselineCompileFunctions) because a Debugger observing the realm forces debug-mode wasm compilation.
verification.parent_plus_real_fix: Rebuilt the tree with the complete golden.diff applied and ran the same probe: it prints 'expected trap: RuntimeError: dereferencing null pointer' and exits 0. The call_ref site has a stackmap, compilation verifies, and the null call_ref traps as an ordinary catchable WebAssembly.RuntimeError.
verification.notes: Build via: cp .mozconfig /tmp/viper-single-mozconfig && printf '\nmk_add_options AUTOCLOBBER=1\n' >> /tmp/viper-single-mozconfig && MOZCONFIG=/tmp/viper-single-mozconfig ./mach build -j8. Debug+ASan build, so the DEBUG-only CheckStackMapsForTraps verifier is active.
